title: aiomfac-surrogates: reproducibility material for "Neural-network surrogates for AIOMFAC" (Parts 1 and 2)
description: Code, data, trained networks and results that reproduce the tables and figures of the two-part paper series Neural-network surrogates for AIOMFAC: Part 1, thermodynamically consistent binary water–organic activity coefficients, molecular representation and data scale; Part 2, thermodynamically consistent activity coefficients of aqueous electrolyte mixtures and organic–electrolyte coupling. All surrogates of version 3 predict an excess Gibbs energy (folder excess_gibbs/); the material of the earlier versions is kept. All AIOMFAC calls use aiomfac_py, a pure-Python port of the AIOMFAC model. See CHANGELOG.md.
